clue.text: Attractive workers love me

blocks.note: hands are farm or factory workers
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone vain boasts that the staff adore them, which proves how attractive they are.
explanation.definitionFit: Handsome is a synonym describing someone good-looking, so it can replace attractive in a sentence.

clue.text: Misers sadly negligent

indicators.note: something done sadly is done badly or wrongly, so the letters beside it are put out of order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A judgement on penny-pinchers: regrettably they fail in their duties.
explanation.definitionFit: Remiss is a synonym meaning careless in one's duty, the same sense as negligent.

clue.text: Report about for example downgrade

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word goes round the other

blocks.note: to relate a story is to report it
e.g. is the abbreviation for 'for example'

explanation.surface: An instruction to report on a matter, for instance a downgrade, in some business memo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Report' reads as a noun at first; it is the verb, to tell a story.
explanation.definitionFit: To relegate is to move to a lower rank or division, a synonym of downgrade.

clue.text: Sticks up for attempt

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means reading the letters from bottom to top

blocks.note: bats are sticks used in cricket or baseball

explanation.surface: Someone stands up for a bold try, defending an effort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sticks up for' reads like the phrasal verb meaning defends; it splits into the wordplay plus a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A stab at something is an informal noun for a try, so it replaces attempt.

clue.text: Whistle-blower returning holding gun for yeoman

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, so the word is read right to left
holding means gripping something inside, so one piece sits within the other

blocks.note: a referee blows the whistle in a match; REF is the short form
an arm is a weapon such as a gun

explanation.surface: An informant comes back armed, hunting a landowner of the old sort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whistle-blower' suggests an informant, but here it is the match official.
explanation.definitionFit: A yeoman was historically a man farming his own small estate, so the farming sense fits.

clue.text: Book a court before start of session

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, so only that is kept

blocks.note: taken as written
CT is the standard abbreviation for court
the opening letter of session

explanation.surface: An instruction to reserve a courtroom ahead of the day's hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book' looks like a verb meaning reserve; it is the noun, a book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Acts of the Apostles is a book of the New Testament, so the answer is an example of a book.

clue.text: Regularly embattled partner

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every second letter is taken

blocks.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters

explanation.surface: A spouse who is constantly under siege.
explanation.definitionFit: A mate is a spouse or companion, a common synonym for a partner.

clue.text: Charm way in

blocks.note: first meaning: a verb, to delight or bewitch, stressed on the second syllable
second meaning: a noun, a door or opening, stressed on the first syllable

explanation.walkthrough: The two meanings share spelling but are pronounced differently.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb sense means to fill with delight, and the noun sense is a doorway or gate giving access.

clue.text: Counsel failing to follow a direction initially

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the word before it
to follow means to come after, fixing the order of the parts

blocks.note: taken as written
the first letter of direction
a vice is a moral failing

explanation.surface: A lawyer who fails to take a line of instruction from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Counsel' and 'failing' suggest a barrister falling short; failing is a noun, a fault.
explanation.definitionFit: Counsel as a noun means guidance offered to someone, a synonym of advice.

clue.text: Provide inspiration for puzzle

blocks.note: to be someone's muse is to inspire them

explanation.surface: A setter is urged to supply the creative spark for a crossword.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Puzzle' looks like a noun, a crossword; it is the verb, to baffle.
explanation.definitionFit: To bemuse someone is to confuse or bewilder them, so it is a synonym of the verb puzzle.

clue.text: Jerseys maybe in place for turning

indicators.note: turning means going round to face the other way, so the word is read backwards

blocks.note: a spot is a place

explanation.surface: Sweaters, perhaps, are stored somewhere ready for a change of season.
explanation.walkthrough: A jersey is a knitted pullover, one example of a top.
explanation.definitionFit: Tops are upper-body garments, and jerseys are an example, which 'maybe' signals.

clue.text: A quiet father is conspicuous

blocks.note: taken as written
p is piano, the musical direction for soft
a father is a parent

explanation.surface: A paradox: a silent dad still stands out.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparent means clearly visible or obvious, a synonym of conspicuous.

clue.text: A nice pet playing game

indicators.note: playing suggests fooling about, so the letters are moved into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A friendly animal joining in a game.
explanation.walkthrough: Patience is the British name for the card game Americans call solitaire.
explanation.definitionFit: Patience is a one-player card game, so it is an example of a game.

clue.text: Attest to sailor being involved in racket

indicators.note: being involved in something means being caught up inside it, so one piece sits within another

blocks.note: a tar is a sailor
a racket is a loud noise

explanation.surface: A witness confirms a seaman was mixed up in a criminal scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Racket' suggests a criminal operation; here it means din.
explanation.definitionFit: To notarise is to certify a document officially, which is a formal way to attest it.

clue.text: Break by front part of car seat

blocks.note: the head is the front of a queue or procession
a rest is a break

explanation.surface: A smashed car seat, damaged at the front.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'part of car seat', not 'car seat'; 'Break by front' means a break placed beside a front.
explanation.definitionFit: A headrest is the cushion on top of a car seat supporting the head, so it is part of one.

clue.text: Served up duck in swanky hotel enchanting diners initially

indicators.note: initially says that the first letter of each preceding word is used

blocks.clueFragment: duck in swanky hotel enchanting diners
blocks.note: the opening letters of these six words

explanation.surface: A smart hotel serves duck that delights its guests.
explanation.definitionFit: To dish up food is to serve it, so dished means served up.

clue.text: Insect seen in 30 day period (not November)

indicators.note: not tells the solver to leave out the letter November represents

blocks.note: many months have thirty days
November is N in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: A bug spotted during a thirty-day month other than November.
explanation.definitionFit: A moth is a winged nocturnal insect related to butterflies.

clue.text: Gosh, going round university can revolt

indicators.note: going round means encircling, so one part is wrapped around the rest

blocks.note: 'My!' is an exclamation of surprise like 'Gosh!'
U is the abbreviation for university
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: Astonishment that a college could rebel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' reads as the verb; it is the noun, a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A mutiny is a rebellion, especially by sailors or soldiers, so it is a noun synonym of revolt.

clue.text: Drink from bag rejected by little sister

indicators.note: something rejected is sent back, so the word is read the other way

blocks.note: a sac is a bag-like pouch
sis is a short form of sister

explanation.surface: A child refuses a drink in a bag offered by her younger sister.
explanation.definitionFit: Cassis is a blackcurrant liqueur, so it is a kind of alcoholic drink.

clue.text: A path abroad

blocks.note: taken as written
a way is a path

explanation.surface: A track in a foreign land.
explanation.definitionFit: Being away means absent from home, which matches the adverb abroad, in another country.

clue.text: Set out around island to find location

indicators.note: out suggests disordered or wrong, so these letters are rearranged
around means encircling, so the rearranged letters wrap the next piece

blocks.note: taken as written
I is the abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: Sailing round an island in search of somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set out' reads as the phrasal verb meaning departed; here the first word is the fodder and the second rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: A site is a place where something is or happens, a synonym of location.

clue.text: Former partner and communist returning to force

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the word is read from the end

blocks.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
Trot is short for Trotskyist, a type of communist

explanation.surface: An ex-lover and a red come back to compel someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To extort is to obtain by coercion, so it means to force money or favours out of someone.

clue.text: Grand old lady in charge when holding crack

indicators.note: holding means keeping something within, so one part goes inside the others

blocks.note: one's old lady is one's mother, ma
a crack is a joke or jest

explanation.walkthrough: 'Crack' suggests a break; it means a wisecrack.
explanation.definitionFit: Grand and majestic are synonyms describing something impressive and stately.

clue.text: US agency stricken as administrator hides

indicators.note: hides means conceals within, so the letters are tucked inside the words before it

blocks.note: spans the end of stricken, all of as and the start of administrator
